test_patch_submodule_context: test patching os.path.join in a module using patch_submodule as a context manager
test_patch_submodule_builtin: test patching builtin open function in a module with patch_submodule
test_patch_submodule_missing: test patching a nonexistent module attribute gracefully without raising errors
test_patch_submodule_start_stop: test manually starting and stopping patch_submodule without using context manager syntax
test_patch_submodule_successive: test applying multiple nested patch_submodule patches in different orders
